Both actual stone feet/boots stay attached where applicable; spectral character has NO boots or invented walking legs. No mirrored view or flipped costume. All figures isolated by generous transparent gutters, with ample margins for complete hair, fists and prone body on all edges.
Truly transparent RGBA, crisp stepped pixel contours and limited shade bands. Body/outfit only; no floor, shadow, captions, grid, held weapon, projectile, detached shards, duplicate actor, warning ring, spell glow, smoke, aura or external FX. Solid own body, truthful physical foot contact.

For rear views front seal is OCCLUDED by torso/hair; NEVER paint clasped hands on spine/back/head. Rear release shows one descending sleeve on one silhouette side and outward open palm on other. No ring, clone, magic FX, shadow or prop baked. Keep all figures below60percent cell height,15percent blank top/bottom,120px clear gutters. Actual native pixel style and own body proportions.
